svg.title: Distinct digit example: three times six plus five equals twenty-three
svg.desc: For a times b plus c equals 23, with distinct digits from one to nine, the product must be between 14 and 22. One solution is a equals 3, b equals 6 and c equals 5.

g.text: 1 ≤ a, b, c ≤ 9 · a ≠ b ≠ c ≠ a
quiz.ckautoflow.com · One valid solution, not necessarily unique
